## Functions

- [`ggtitle`](ggtitle.qmd) - Shortcut for setting the plot title (and optional subtitle).
- [`labs`](labs.qmd) - Build a label dictionary for the plot title, subtitle, caption, and axes.
- [`xlab`](xlab.qmd) - Shortcut for setting the x axis title.
- [`ylab`](ylab.qmd) - Shortcut for setting the y axis title.
